full_prompt_en: A square, stylized digital landscape shows a glowing turquoise river winding through a compact village of pale buildings and rounded trees at night. The sky is a deep blue-black band across the top, broken by low gray clouds and a tiny cool light point. Behind the settlement, hills rise in overlapping arcs of teal, olive, rust, and almost black, each covered with slender vertical groves. On the left, small cream and tan houses with dark roofs cluster beneath the hill, their few windows glowing warm yellow. A low arched bridge crosses the water near the middle-left and leads toward the brighter central bank. In the foreground, the river bends from the lower-left corner around a dark island and continues toward the right, its smooth cyan surface reflecting a few of the lamps. Tall narrow trees stand along the island edge, while larger circular canopies gather at the right and upper center. Their surfaces carry dense tiny stipples that give the simple spheres and domes a velvety texture. At the right, a line of taller pale yellow houses climbs the slope, punctuated by warm windows and an open archway near the water. A small walking figure appears on the path by the river, reduced to a dark mark against the lighter ground. Deep shadow closes around the tree trunks and hill bases, while warm amber light glows from openings and a few narrow passages. The forms are cleanly simplified, but fine patterning in foliage and gentle gradients across the hills preserve visual richness. Light is low and localized, with the river supplying cool reflected brightness and the windows supplying warm points. The overall composition feels dreamlike and sheltered, guiding the eye along the sinuous luminous water between clustered architecture and rounded nocturnal greenery.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、风格化的数字风景描绘一条发亮的蓝绿色河流，夜间弯过由浅色房屋和圆润树木构成的紧凑村庄。天空是一条横过顶部的深蓝黑色带，被低矮灰云和一个细小冷色亮点打断。村庄后方，山丘以青蓝、橄榄绿、铁锈红和近黑色的弧形层层升起，每层都覆着细长的竖向树林。左侧，小小的奶油色和棕黄色房屋聚在山下，深色屋顶之间有几扇暖黄色亮窗。中左部，一座低拱桥跨过水面，通向较亮的中央河岸。前景河流从左下角弯过一块深色小岛，向右继续，平滑的青蓝水面映出几处灯光。细长高树沿岛边站立，右侧和上部中央聚着更大的圆形树冠。树冠表面布满密集细点，使简洁的圆球和穹形带有丝绒般肌理。右侧，一列更高的浅黄色房屋沿坡上升，暖色窗户点亮其间，水边还有一道开放拱门。河旁小路上有一个步行的小人物，缩成浅色地面上的深色笔迹。深影围住树干和山脚，暖琥珀色光从洞口和几条窄路中透出。形状干净而简化，叶片中的细密纹样和山丘上的柔和渐变仍保留丰富视觉内容。光线低弱且局部集中，河流提供冷色反光亮度，窗户则提供暖色光点。整体构图如梦而受庇护，沿着弯曲发光的水道，把视线引到聚集的建筑和圆润的夜间绿意之间。
style_prompt_en: The digital illustration combines simplified rounded silhouettes with dense velvety stipple and softly graded color. Deep navy, charcoal teal, olive, rust, and amber overlap in clear layers, while narrow cyan ribbons and small golden points provide luminous contrast. Circular and columnar rhythms alternate across the frame, giving complex depth without naturalistic clutter. Edges remain clean at major shapes but soften within tiny dotted textures and atmospheric hill gradients. Light is low and localized: cool reflections open a path through dark masses, and warm pinpoints mark selected recesses. A winding bright line guides the eye between clustered vertical accents and large rounded forms. The overall effect is whimsical and nocturnal, with tactile pattern and balanced warm-cool glow giving the scene its character.
style_prompt_zh: 数字插画把简化的圆润剪影、密集丝绒般点纹和柔和渐变色结合起来。深海军蓝、炭青色、橄榄绿、铁锈红与琥珀色在清晰层次中重叠，狭窄的青蓝色亮带和细小金色光点提供发光对比。圆形与柱形节奏在全幅交替，在不依赖自然主义杂乱细节的情况下形成复杂纵深。主要形状边缘保持干净，细小点状肌理和有空气感的山坡渐变内部则更柔和。光线低弱且局部集中：冷色反光在暗色体块间打开通道，暖色小光点标出选定的凹处。一条弯曲亮线在聚集的竖向重音和大块圆润形体之间引导视线。整体效果奇妙而夜色浓郁，可触纹样和均衡的冷暖光泽赋予画面性格。
theme_en: A glowing river winding through a rounded nighttime village
theme_zh: 一条发亮的河流穿过圆润树木环绕的夜间村庄
name: George Callaghan
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
